name: Ramp
text: To enhance accessibility in EXCAVA, we should implement a clear focus ring for all interactive elements. This change ensures that users navigating with a keyboard can easily identify which element is currently selected, improving the navigation experience. The trade-off here is that the visual design may be slightly affected; however, prioritizing usability for those relying on keyboard navigation significantly outweighs aesthetic considerations. Making this adjustment will help ensure that EXCAVA is usable by everyone, including those with visual impairments.

name: Reader
text: The risk isn’t just visual clutter—it’s that a focus ring could *confuse* users if it’s too heavy or misaligned with the design. A better alternative is testing two focus ring styles (subtle vs. bold) with real keyboard users and measuring if they can complete tasks faster. Settle it by running a quick 5-user usability test with screen-reader users and comparing task success rates.
